en.title: Disney Denies Veteran DAS Access; Microsoft Updates SharePoint; Major Accessibility Projects Advance
en.summary: Disney denied a PTSD veteran's Disability Access Service accommodation despite prior approval, sparking criticism. Microsoft announced a SharePoint visual refresh to improve accessibility across Microsoft 365, while St. George’s completed a $3M renovation and Boone County Fair added accessible pathways and services. Experts note accessibility 2.0 is becoming a leadership conversation across sectors.

highlights.title: Disney Denies DAS Accommodations to PTSD Veteran Despite Prior Approval
Microsoft Refreshes SharePoint Design to Improve Accessibility
Accessibility 2.0 Is Becoming A Leadership Conversation

zh-TW.title: Disney 拒絕 PTSD 退伍軍人 DAS；微軟更新 SharePoint；多項無障礙項目進展
zh-TW.summary: Disney 拒絕一名患有 PTSD 的退伍軍人使用 DAS 便利設施，儘管事先已獲批准，引發爭議。微軟宣布對 SharePoint 進行視覺更新以提升無障礙性，同時 St. George’s 完成 300 萬美元無障礙翻修，Boone County 博覽會增設無障礙通道與服務。業界指出無障礙 2.0 正成為各領導層討論的重點。
